questions.stem: James won first prize and will be ________ exchange student in New Zealand next year.
questions.expl: 句意：詹姆斯获得了一等奖，明年将作为交换生去新西兰。 考查冠词。the 特指；/零冠词；an 泛指，一个，用于元音音素开头单词前；a 泛指，一个，用于辅 音音素开头单词前。根据“James won first prize and will be... exchange student in New Zealand next year.”可知，此处为泛指，且“exchange”为元音音素开头的单词。故选C。

questions.stem: You can’t expect ________a foreign language in a few months.
questions.expl: 句意：你不能指望在几个月内学会一门外语。 考查动词不定式。learn 学习，动词原形；learning 学习，动名词或现在分词形式；to learn 去学习， 动词不定式；learnt 学习了，动词过去式或过去分词。根据“You can’t expect...a foreign language in a few months.”可知，句中“expect to do sth.”是固定搭配，意为“期望做某事”，“expect”后需接动词不 定式作宾语。故选C。

questions.stem: —Do you feel ________ when you live ________?—No, I have two dogs and three cats. They’re all my friends.
—________ do you ________ your old watch?—I am going to get it repaired.
Many of my classmates have lived in Suqian ________ they were born.
questions.expl: 句意：我的很多同学自出生起就一直生活在宿迁。 考查从属连词辨析。for 因为；when 当……时；since 自从；before 在……之前。根据“Many of my classmates have lived in Suqian... they were born.”可知，此处是“现在完成时+since+一般过去时”结构， 故选C。

questions.stem: ________ unique experience Bailing had on Hainan Island with her fellow campers!
questions.expl: 句意：百灵和她的营员同伴们在海南岛经历了一次多么独特的体验啊！ 考查感叹句。根据“unique experience Bailing had on Hainan Island with her fellow campers!”可知，此 处为感叹句，由于unique experience 是名词短语，故此处应用“What +a/an +形容词+名词...”的结构， 由于“unique”以辅音音素开头，故应用a。故选B。

questions.stem: It takes us 2 hours _________ to Huai’an by taking the Nanjing-Huai’an high-speed railway.
questions.expl: 句意：坐南京至淮安高速铁路到淮安需要两个小时。 考查非谓语动词。此处是句型It takes sb. some time to do sth.“花费某人多长时间干某事”，其中it 是形式主语，真正的主语是动词不定式。故选A。

questions.stem: —Ne Zha 2 ________15 billion yuan at the box office so far.—It’s a pride of Chinese movies.
questions.expl: 句意：——《哪吒2》到目前为止已经取得了150 亿元的票房。——这是中国电影的骄傲。 考查动词时态。根据时间状语“so far”可知，这句话用现在完成时，故选B。

questions.stem: Look, Jane is very ______, because she can’t find her purse.
questions.expl: 句意：看，简很焦虑，因为她找不到她的钱包了。happy 开心的；surprised 惊讶的；anxious 焦虑的；excited 激动的。找不到钱包表现得应该很焦虑，故选C。

questions.stem: ---Tom, do you know where Jiayou supermarket is?
questions.expl: 试题分析：句意：汤姆，你知道价优超市在哪里吗？对不起，我不熟悉这个城市，你可以 问比尔，他对这个地方很熟悉。is unfamiliar to sb 对某人来说不熟悉，is familiar with sth 对某物很 熟悉，故选C 考点：动词固定短语 点评：解答此类题目并不难，关键是理解句意和熟悉选项的固定用法。对于这样的动词固定短语， 平时学习过程中唯有认真的记忆，遇到了就积累，并抽时间不断的复习重复，才是将此类题目做好 的方法。 二、语法选择(本大题共10 小题，每小题1 分，满分10 分) Hi, Fred! I’m writing to let you know how things have been going during my term in Spain. I 11 here for six weeks and I feel like I am finally adapting to (适应) the culture. I arrived during 12 week of September. Even though it’s October, it’s still quite sunny and warm. In fact, I went to the beach and swam earlier today. I am living with 13 very welcoming host family. I have my own bedroom, but we eat breakfast, lunch, and dinner together. On Sundays, we eat a big home-cooked food for lunch. In Spain, lunch is usually the 14 meal of the day. On weekdays, I take classes at the local university. There, I met 15 Spanish speakers. They have been very kind and patient with me. At first, I didn’t understand 16 Spanish very well, but now I understand most of our conversations. My Spanish has improved a lot since we first 17. Now, I’m 18 to use the language in other places like stores and restaurants than before. I am so glad that I decided to spend the term here in Spain. We have another weekend coming up, so a group of my friends and I are going to travel to France for four days. It’s so easy and cheap to travel here in Europe. It’s full 19 fun. I look forward to 20 from you soon. Stay in touch more often. Perhaps you could even come to visit! What do you think? Looking forward to your reply! Yours, Patrick
：我在这里已经六个星期了，我觉得我终于适应了这里的文化。 am 一般现在时；was 一般过去时；has been 现在完成时；have been 现在完成时。根据“for six weeks” 可知，此处用现在完成时，主语是I，助动词用have。故选D。
：我是在九月的第一个星期到的。 one 一，基数词；first 第一，序数词；the one 特指那个；the first 定冠词the+序数词。根据“I arrived during...week of September.”可知，此处表示九月的第一个星期，故选D。
：我住在一个非常热情的寄宿家庭。 a 泛指一个，用于辅音音素开头的单词前；an 泛指一个，用于元音音素开头的单词前；the 定冠词 表特指；/零冠词。此处泛指一个寄宿家庭，“very”首字母发辅音音素，故选A。
：在西班牙，午餐通常是一天中最丰盛的一餐。 big 形容词原级；bigger 形容词比较级；biggest 形容词最高级；bigness 名词。此处作定语，空前有 the 修饰，所以用形容词最高级。故选C。
：在那里，我遇到了一些说西班牙语的人。 some 一些；any 任何；a lot 十分；a little 有一点。此处是肯定句，修饰“Spanish speakers”，故选A。
：起初，我不太懂他们的西班牙语，但现在我能听懂我们大部分的对话。 they 他们，主格；them 他们，宾格；their 他们的，形容词性物主代词；themselves 他们自己，反身 代词。此处作定语修饰Spanish，用形容词性物主代词。故选C。
：自从我们第一次见面以来，我的西班牙语进步了很多。 met 一般过去时；meet 一般现在时，动词原形；meets 一般现在时，动词三单；have met 现在完成 时。since 引导的从句用一般过去时，故选A。
：现在，我比以前更有信心在商店和餐馆等其他地方使用英语。
：它充满了乐趣。 in 在里面；of 关于；with 和；from 从。be full of“充满”，固定短语，故选B。
：我期待很快收到你的来信。 hear 动词原形；hearing 动名词/现在分词；heard 动词过去式；hears 动词三单。look forward to doing sth“期待做某事”，故选B。
：他们因为不同的原因出国。 main 主要的；strong 强壮的；different 不同的；good 好的。根据“Many western children go on student exchange programs.For example...”可知，此处列举了不同的学生选择出国的原因，学生们出国的原 因各不相同。故选C。
：他想要去遥远的地方旅游，交一些朋友，改善英语。 place 地方；station 车站；village 村庄；forest 森林。根据“travel to a faraway”可知，此处指去某地 旅游，faraway place 表示“遥远的地方”。故选A。
：一个来自加拿大的十五岁女孩Jean，在瑞典学习一年了。 lied 撒谎；travelled 旅行；worked 工作；studied 学习。根据“ She wanted to learn another language and see how people in Europe lived...”可知她想要学习另一门语言，因此是在瑞典学习。故选D。
：她想要学习另一门语言，看看英国人如何生活，因此她申请了她学校的交换生项目。 because 因为；but 但是；so 因此；if 如果。根据句意可知，此空表因果关系的连词，前因后果，用 so 连接。故选C。
：幸运地是，她得到了这次机会。 chance 机会；book 书；gift 礼物；change 改变。根据“... she applied for the student exchange programs in her school.”可知此处指交换生的机会。故选A。
：他们中的一些想要学习新语言，但是交朋友才是他们最期待的。 look after 照顾；look up 向上看；look through 浏览；look forward to 期待。根据“Some of them want to learn a new language...”可知此处指他们想要出国的原因，D 选项符合。故选D。
：在美国或者英国，他们通常在暑假期间参加一个三周或者六周的露营来提高他们的英语 技能。 try on 试穿；go on 继续；put on 穿上；hold on 等一下。go on a camp 表示“去露营”。故选B。

：一般来说，亚洲的学生选择去说英语的国家。 fail 失败；choose 选择；refuse 拒绝；remember 记住。根据“They want to experience different cultures and make new friends, but most of them... want to improve their English ability. ”可知他们选择去说英 语的国家，来提高英语能力。故选B。
：他们想要体验不同的文化，交新朋友，但是大多数特别想要提高英语能力。
：他们希望当回到本国学校时，有更好的英语技能来帮助他们提高分数。 clearer 更清楚；harder 更努力；easier 更简单；better 更好。根据“ help improve their grades”可知更 好的英语技能能够帮助他们得到更好的成绩。故选D。

questions.stem: Language students in a UK university spend their ________ year abroad.
questions.expl: 理解题。根据“They usually spend the third year abroad—they go to a country where the language they are learning is spoken.”可知，语言类学生要在国外度过第三年，故选C。

questions.stem: The underlined word “That” refers to (指的是) “________”.
opts: Learning the language of a country
Practising what one has learnt at university
Living with a host family in a foreign country
Understanding a country’s culture, people and traditions
questions.expl: 猜测题。根据“They can not only learn the language, but also come to understand the culture, the people, and the traditions of the country. That is an important part of language learning.”可知，了解这个 国家的文化、人民和传统是学习语言的一个重要部分，所以That 指代“Understanding a country’s culture, people and traditions”，故选D。

理解题。根据“She taught English in a language school”可知，她在一所语言学校教英语，故 选D。 34．细节理解题。根据“And my students are also my friends. They show me how people speak and live in the country. That’s helpful in improving my French.”可知，她的学生们帮助她提高法语，故选A。

questions.stem: Who helped Ellen Rothnie improve her French in Paris?

opts: everyone should learn a foreign language
one year abroad is good for language students
more students need to go to Paris to learn French
university students should get more than one degree
questions.expl: 判断题。根据最后一段可知，在国外的一年很有趣，但也很有压力，但是一旦学生们适应 了新的生活方式，一切就会变得容易一些，许多人会把他们在国外的一年描述为他们一生中最棒的 经历之一，由此可知，作者可能认为国外一年对学语言的学生有好处的，故选B。

questions.stem: What is the unseen part of culture?
opts: The part of above the water.
The under part of the iceberg.
questions.expl: 理解题。根据“And the ‘unseen’ part is the way people think, such as how we see life and death.” 可知，文化中看不见的部分是人们思考的方式。故选B。

questions.stem: If somebody says “You are excellent!”, how do Chinese usually reply?
opts: I am sorry to hear that.
questions.expl: 理解题。根据“we’re likely to reply by saying ‘Not at all’ or ‘I’m not that great’”可知，中国人 在受到赞扬时通常会谦逊地回答“我没那么好”。故选D。

questions.stem: Which word is close to the underlined word “mourning”?
Which can be a proper title for the text?
opts: There are Two Sides of Each Problem
The Iceberg Model and Different Cultures
questions.expl: 标题题。通读全文，文章主要讲述成都育才中学的学生用冰山模式来理解不同文化的例子， 因此选项C“冰山模式与不同文化”最为恰当。故选C。

questions.stem: How many days may the exchange program last?
questions.expl: 理解题。根据“Every summer, some students can study there and stay with host families for two and a half weeks”可知交换生项目会持续两个半星期，可能是18 天。故选B。

questions.stem: According to Paragraph 2, why was the Great Wall the highlight of the trip?
opts: Because the Great Wall is a famous landmark.
Because the Great Wall is an ancient building.
Because the writer first saw the real Great Wall.
Because the writer had seen the Great Wall in videos and pictures.
questions.expl: 理解题。根据“The highlight of our trip was the Great Wall. Seeing it in person for the first time was amazing even though I had seen hundreds of videos and pictures before.”可知由于是第一次亲眼看 到长城，所以作者认为旅行中最精彩的部分是游览长城。故选C。

questions.stem: What can we learn from Paragraph 2 and 3?
opts: The writer loved the trip in China.
The writer loved eating Chinese breakfast.
The writer flew from Beijing to Nanjing.
The writer went to China with parents.
questions.expl: 判断题。第二段描述了在中国吃早餐、游览北京著名地标，尤其是看到长城时的震撼；第 三段提到寄宿家庭很热情，在学校参加各种课程了解中国文化。这些都表明作者喜欢这次中国之旅。 故选A。

questions.stem: According to the writer, what are the meaningful parts of being an exchange student?①Leaving parents.②Staying in a host family.③Knowing about a different culture.④Making friends with local people.
questions.expl: 理解题。根据“I am forever thankful to my high school for giving me the opportunity to exchange in China and to immerse (沉浸在) myself in its culture and meet amazing friends who I still keep in touch with today”可知作者认为作为一名交换生，最有意义之处在于了解一种不同的文化， 以及和当地人交朋友。故选C。

questions.stem: Where can we probably read this passage?
questions.expl: 判断题。通读全文可知，文章主要讲述了作者在中国做交换生的经历，由此推测，我们可 能在博客上看到这篇文章。故选D。
